digest.component_or_area: plan-review severity axis (undecomposed), plan-v3/v4 impact model
propositions: The 'undecomposed' hard-override axis fires on 0.107% (plan-v3) and 0.153% (plan-v4) of verified findings—its stated justification (G5 deterministic suppressor) is inert: zero fires across 2,000 reviews and inapplicable to 90%+ of childless reviewed tickets.

The axis gates a 0.85 hard-override floor for any non-none grade, conflating low/medium/high; 25 of 29 fires are load-bearing hard-override blocks despite being graded low, and at least one low-grade finding blocks on the floor alone—identical miscalibration previously fixed for ac_unverifiable and divergent_implementation.

The inverse population (findings matching _G5_UNDECOMPOSED_RE text but scoring undecomposed=none) is 33 plan-v3 + 17 plan-v4 matches; sampled inspection confirms these are code-decomposition false positives, not missed flat-plan defects.

The axis's hedge text in verify_models.py and both reviewer prompts cites the inert G5 suppressor as justification for conservative grading, but audit shows zero veto fires and zero coverage.g5_undecomposed_vetoed keys recorded across all sidecars.
